title: Ancient Demon
summary: An hour earlier, knowing the Mad Demon Fruit would wear off, Wang Lin forced the captive Yao Xixue to reveal how the Blood Soul Pill works, so his clone survives the self-destruction that wrecks the Demon Tower. The Scattered Devil, in a body that looks like Ling Tianhou's, hunts him on the plains outside Sky Demon City, and Wang Lin calls on the Ancient Demon, who arrives and fights the devil, revealing it is only one of nine Scattered Devils serving another Ancient. Watching their fight, which resembles the Ancient God arts, gives Wang Lin's true body insight into Ancient God techniques, and Wang Lin finally lures the Scattered Devil into his own divine soul with Xu Liguo and the Holy Soul Flag so that the Ancient Demon, Bei Lou, has to help seal it. Back on Planet Vermilion, people of the Cloud Sky Sect in the Chu Country remember Wang Lin as a legend and light candles for him. In his sea of consciousness Wang Lin stabilises Ascendant and suppresses the devil to devour later as a second soul, and at the Dragon Pool Bei Lou names him Heavenly Demon Envoy, above the Demon Emperor, promising to find his friend in the coming war with Fire Demon Country.
